prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Regional Dispatch Center (Juniper): authorized dispatch, degraded-radio/surge procedures, audit retention/access controls; records restriction rationale/scope/duration; reviews thresholds, demand/coverage/delay/communications/data quality. Computer Aided Dispatch Console: confirmed status/time/source; approved-scenario testing before authorization. Ambulance Coordination Platform: approved instructions/destinations/statuses, separate mutual aid, buffering/reconciliation; monitor availability/latency/integrity/interfaces; assess operational/clinical/security/continuity impacts before release. Release records: owner/evidence/limitations/rollback. Call Taker Mara (Larkspur): verifies caller/location/pediatric details, retains caller during fallback; produces Caller Location Correction Slip; checks Bedside Arrival Receipt. Triage Supervisor (Copperfield): priority/reassessment/disagreement/surge/overrides; sends Pediatric Acuity Note; reviews duplicate-closure audit memo and acuity/escalation risk. Pediatric airway/breathing/circulation/mental-status concerns require escalation. Regional Medical Director: clinical/destination advice, no dispatch authority; approves regional clinical-guidance changes; reviews significant events with Shift Commander. Dispatcher: matches needs/readiness/capability/coverage/time; failed voice requires approved data fallback, timestamped attempts; reconciles restoration discrepancies. Shift Commander (Sundial): approves coverage/nonstandard exceptions, receives Coverage Gap Bulletin, sends Mutual Aid Release Form; may restrict unsafe capabilities; authority until acknowledged succession. Handover: incidents/failures/channels/decisions; incoming verification. Radio Coordinator (Mistral): verifies backups/routes, transmits assignments/hazards/destinations/bulletin, retries/escalates acknowledgments; uses Unit Staging Change Card and South Access Lane Notice. Regional Radio Network: call-sign traffic/outage announcements/planned checks; post-change checks before reuse. Paramedic Crew: acknowledgment/repetition, protocol care/reassessment/reports; confirmed safe routing. Ambulance Unit 417: confirmed movements/status/staging/handover/restoration reports. Fleet Maintenance Cell (Bluejay): faults/restrictions/clearance; Battery Swap Voucher; uses Mutual Aid Release Form; preventive scheduling; asset/work/parts/return-to-service records. Hospital Liaison Desk (Kestrel): capacity/constraints, forwards acuity note, telephone fallback, privacy-preserving review observations. Emergency Department: capacity/access/destination acknowledgment/discrepancies/backup arrivals. Data Quality Officer: Pebble timestamp conflicts/completeness/consistency/outcomes. North Approach Queue Snapshot informs

New part:
S247: The Regional Dispatch Center provides a periodic summary of assurance activities, open risks, and improvement progress to regional oversight.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
